name: fast-gliner-compaction
description: Verbatim compaction for Claude Code sessions, scored by a self-hosted GLiNER2.5 decision model.

serverUrl.title: Decision server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of the fast-gliner-compaction server (local or a GPU host). Leave unset to use FGC_SERVER_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:8765.

serverToken.title: Decision server token
serverToken.description: Bearer token matching the server's FGC_TOKEN. Leave unset to use FGC_TOKEN from the environment.

model.title: Decision model
model.description: gliner-decide (340M, default), gliner-decide-1b, gliner-multi-decide, laya, or laya-multilingual. The server loads it on first use unless FGC_LAZY=0.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum model probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Outline token budget
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation outline included with every decision. Larger reads more history but costs quadratically more model time; lower it on CPU hosts.

focusResultChars.title: Focus output characters
focusResultChars.description: Characters of a tool result shown to the model when deciding about that call.

maxRequestItems.title: Decisions per request
maxRequestItems.description: Tool calls scored per server request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when the model decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.
